questions.prompt: In October, 1962, US President Kennedy met advisers to discuss ______ which proved that the Cubans were installing nuclear missiles, presumably to use against the US. Kennedy chose (39) option, which prevented the build up of more missiles and led to the withdrawal of the existing ones. Most are agreed that a (40) was narrowly avoided by Kennedy's decision.
